comment: Real fetch paths traced 2026-07-27 for the 4 pages named in the noticing brief. Zero new endpoints/queries — rules.json only reads fields already present in these payloads (or the compile-time snapshot).

payloadShape.courses: Array<{ code, name, new_app_status, legacy_app_status, content_status, pricing_tier, export_ready, seed_count, created_at, updated_at, stats: { seeds, completedSeeds, legos, phrases, audio } }>

noticingFieldsAbsent: no known-vocab breach field anywhere in this payload -> R1 must be snapshot-sourced, joined by courses[].code
no voice_config / audio_pass_requests field -> cannot support an admin voice-config/audio-pass rule from this payload

CourseManager.vue.mount: course-manager (not a rule mount point named in the contract; not used below)
endpointsCalled: GET {builderApi}/api/stats/:code (services/production-api.cjs:1059) -> { total_seeds, completed_seeds, seeds_with_legos, legos, legos_total, phrases, ratio, avg_phrase_score, scored_phrases }
noticingFieldsAbsent: no known-vocab, voice-config, or audio_pass_requests field in any call -> confirmed not a source for rules (b)/(c)

endpointsCalled: GET {api}/api/production/:code/recording-script (services/production-api.cjs:7205) -> { courseCode, totalItems, totalPhrases, totalDirect, estimatedMinutes, items }. `excludeRecorded` defaults true, so totalItems is already the real remaining GAP for this recorder's course, not a from-scratch count.
RecordRoom.vue.note: Single-course page (courseCode is a route prop) -> rules here are 'node' shape over the one course in view, never perChild. No cross-course list is fetched, so a cross-course 'all pending recorder work' rule is not supportable without a new query.

endpointsCalled: GET {builderApi}/api/qa/flags/:code?status=open (services/course-builder/routes/qa.cjs:1269) -> { course_code, total, by_severity:{error,warning,info}, by_type, flags: Array<{severity, check_type, ...}> }
GET {builderApi}/api/qa/summary/:code -> { phrases:{total,checked,unchecked,progress_percent}, flags:{total,open,errors,warnings} } (Supabase branch instead calls getQAFlags/getQASummary directly)

clientFieldsAssigned.flags: data.flags || []  (array of raw course_qa_flags rows, each carries .severity)

PhraseQA.vue.mount: qa (alternate/legacy QA surface; not used for a rule below — QAReview.vue already covers the qa mount with real per-severity data)
PhraseQA.vue.note: action-trigger page (spawns agents), does not GET a summary/list payload of its own on mount worth reading -> not used as a rule source.

vocabGate.verifiedExample: afr_for_eng: known_breaches=1079, target_breaches=12 (read directly from the file, 2026-07-27)

humanVoiceCourses.shape: Set of exact codes {cym_n_for_eng, cym_s_for_eng, bre_for_fra} + prefix rule /^cym_/
humanVoiceCourses.bakedAs: pack.truth.voicePolicy.humanVoiceCourses (already specified in docs/self-explaining-popty.md §2, not new)
